# Beauty by Kyrin

Beauty by Kyrin is a Las Vegas hair stylist specializing in custom cuts, dimensional color, balayage, highlights, extensions, blowouts, keratin services, deep conditioning, and scalp care.

## Contact

- Stylist: Kyrin Weidauer
- Phone or text: 702-533-8176
- Location: Inside Venus Salon, 8665 W Flamingo Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89147
- Website: https://www.beautybykyrin.com/
- Hours: Tuesday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM

## Booking

Clients can call or text 702-533-8176 or send an appointment request at https://www.beautybykyrin.com/#book.

## Service area

Beauty by Kyrin serves Las Vegas and nearby communities including Henderson, North Las Vegas, Summerlin, Spring Valley, and Enterprise.
